description: This PHP class 'BuzzLink' represents the entity for links associated with buzz posts in the OrangeHRM system, using Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping. It defines properties for id, post, link, and original link, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: BuzzLink
classes.description: Entity class for buzz links, mapped via Doctrine ORM, linked to a BuzzPost, with properties for URLs and ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the BuzzLink entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the BuzzLink entity.
